test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.**

Some plants secrete oils during dry periods, and when it rains, these oils are released on the air.

options.text: dry periods, and when it rains,
these oils are released on the air.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'these oils are released on the air.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence contains an error in the third part: *'these oils are released on the air.'*
 
• The **correct phrasing** should be* "these oils are released **into** the air." *
 
• This is because** "into" **is used to express movement or transformation of something within another thing or place. When the oils are released, they go into the air, becoming part of it. 

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'Some plants secrete oils during dry periods, and when it rains, these oils are released** into** the air.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** ****"On" **is used when something is physically in contact with, and typically, above something else. 

 
 
• **For example-** a book might be placed on a table, but in this case, the oils are not sitting "on" the air, they are released and dispersed into it.
